title: What It Actually Looks Like to Feel the Pull and Not Follow It
caption:
A godly man feels the pull and doesn't follow it. Self-control isn't the absence of desire. It's who wins when desire shows up.

Name the pull before it names you. Build the wall on a Tuesday, not a Friday. Let the want pass through you instead of running you. Governed is stronger than gone.

Christ set you free for freedom, not for numbness.

#faith #selfcontrol #godlymen #christianman #discipleship #freedom #holiness
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
